fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-f835634e at c0cba816 (attempt 5): go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipLocalGate -v passes its subtests: unstable runs the gate in the worktree, stable skips, no gate skips, a failing gate fails with its output. TestShipRebaseRunsLocalGate, TestShipGateFailed and the TestShipRebase* tests pass too. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow passes, including TestShipChangeLocalGate: a gate step before each push step, on.fail to gate-fix, and rebase and rebase-merge failing to rebase-gate-failed (rhiza ship gate --failed, on.pass to gate-fix). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ship-local-gate passes: in its own repo, daemon settings --json lists rhiza.ship.localGate with an empty default (source default), and after daemon set 'make check' it shows make check from git config. describe-golden, run-ship-change, run-ship-change-fail and run-ship-change-rebase pass. The scripts were run with RHIZA_* unset and GOTMPDIR/TMPDIR in a scratch dir, because the run's GOTMPDIR sits inside the main repo's .git, where rhiza init finds the outer repo. The diff fixes the quality finding: a gate that fails on the rebased head leaves main merged in, unpushed, and records gate_failed so gate-fix sees the failure. .rhiza/settings.json and the project settings file layer are gone, which resolves the scope and model findings.
